main.description: A Bardcast character's static identity. Portable across campaigns: keyed in-app on the player's DID so the character can follow them. One record per character at the well-known `self` rkey.

player.description: DID of the player who portrays this character. The durable identity key the character hangs off of.

displayName.description: The character's name as it appears in narration.

concept.description: One-line concept, e.g. 'a guilt-ridden paladin who left her order'.

createdAt.description: Real ISO 8601 creation time. NOT the in-world date (see stateEvent.storyDate).
